Done. All three functions are implemented:

1. **formatBytes(n)** — converts bytes to human-readable format (B, KB, MB, GB) with one decimal place
2. **slugify(title)** — lowercases, trims, replaces space runs with dashes, strips non-alphanumeric characters except dashes
3. **fetchUsers(baseUrl)** — fetches users from the API endpoint, logs the count using the logger, and returns the array
